name: Panda
content:
Panda is a major supporting character in Jujutsu Kaisen.
Despite his name and appearance, Panda is not an actual panda, but instead an Abrupt-Mutation Cursed Corpse created by Masamichi Yaga.
He attends Jujutsu High as a second-year student along with Maki Zenin, Toge Inumaki, and Yuta Okkotsu.
